body: As I glance in the shop window, my reflection stumbles into the shop. I quicken my pace, my eyes darting back and forth to make sure no one is following. The windows behind the shop are empty, but I can sense eyes on me. I pause, looking around, and then I turn down an alleyway to lose myself in the crowd.
